what: The reload gesture's lines said in place of the game's "Shoot outside of the screen!" (sound command a0 14 05) when the trigger is pulled on an empty gun: drop the magazine, load one, rack the slide (arcade.cpp watch_sound_commands, quest_xr.c load_reload_lines).
source: Made for this project by its author with a ComfyUI Chatterbox voice clone of the game's announcer; trimmed and converted to 16-bit mono 22050 Hz WAV (the line's rate).
format: 16-bit PCM, mono, 22050 Hz (baked into the line's place in the sample ROM as signed 8-bit)
